statements.text: Average speed for a trip is total distance divided by total time for that trip.
Her average speed on the return trip is greater than on the outward trip.
Average speed can be found only when she moves at one steady speed the whole time.

stem:
Nila walks 400 m to the shop in 200 s. On the way back she covers the same 400 m in 100 s. Her walking rate changes on both trips.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Average speed is total distance over total time even when motion is not uniform. The return trip takes less time for the same distance, so its average speed is greater. Statement 3 is false.
